metadata.color_semantics: probability density in bohr^-3; the density is unsigned, so no sign is encoded
metadata.geometry_semantics: plane section of probability density |psi|^2 on the xz plane through the origin, sampled row-major with v along rows and u along columns, at the stated time
warnings: all terms share one energy, so this superposition is stationary: the density does not evolve and any apparent motion is an artefact
